why.en: IMAPS on port 993 starts TLS from the first byte. This only opens a TCP connection and does not log in.
why.hinglish: Port 993 par IMAPS pehle byte se TLS shuru karta hai. Ye sirf TCP connection kholta hai, login nahi karta.

expect.en: TcpTestSucceeded : True (or 'succeeded'). Results vary by network.
expect.hinglish: TcpTestSucceeded : True (ya 'succeeded'). Result network ke hisaab se badal sakta hai.

title.en: See the server greeting and capabilities

why.en: Connect over TLS and the server sends its untagged * OK greeting with CAPABILITY list (IDLE, MOVE and so on). We only read it and then log out.
why.hinglish: TLS par connect karo to server apni untagged * OK greeting CAPABILITY list ke saath bhejta hai (IDLE, MOVE waghera). Hum sirf ise padhte hain aur phir log out kar dete hain.

commands.unix: printf 'a1 CAPABILITY\r\na2 LOGOUT\r\n' | openssl s_client -quiet -connect imap.gmail.com:993

expect.en: A line starting with '* OK' and a '* CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 ... IDLE ...' line, then 'a1 OK' and 'a2 OK'. The exact list varies by provider.
expect.hinglish: '* OK' se shuru hone wali line aur '* CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 ... IDLE ...' line, phir 'a1 OK' aur 'a2 OK'. Exact list provider ke hisaab se badalti hai.

title.en: Spot the tagged commands in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark to see the tags (a0, a1 ...) and the untagged * lines before TLS starts.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur TLS shuru hone se pehle tags (a0, a1 ...) aur untagged * lines dekho.

expect.en: The greeting, the STARTTLS command and its reply. After that the packets become TLS and are unreadable.
expect.hinglish: Greeting, STARTTLS command aur uska reply. Uske baad packets TLS ban jaate hain aur padhe nahi ja sakte.

why.en: After STARTTLS the LOGIN is inside TLS. Filter on TLS application data to see only the opaque records.
why.hinglish: STARTTLS ke baad LOGIN TLS ke andar hota hai. TLS application data par filter karo to sirf opaque records dikhte hain.

expect.en: A few small records, matching the lesson's roughly 53 and 121 byte login records. You cannot read the username or password.
expect.hinglish: Kuch chhote records, jo lesson ke lagbhag 53 aur 121 byte wale login records se match karte hain. Username ya password padh nahi sakte.
